full_page.content:
Page 224 Cont.
July 16 Gertrude Rushman - 68 - Throat. . complications
Edith Esper - 45 - Gall - stone - tips
Mrs. Margaret Carroll - 53 - Operation 3 months ago - so many organs were removed that it is terrable - fears another operation out of question unless she can be first built up for such.
Irene - 28 - married out of Church several years ago - has four or five children all unbaptized; now in oxigen tent and given not more than a few days to live.
Mrs. Joanna Dwyer - 88 - feet and shin trouble ....
1940, August
Aug. 5th Patrick Hayes - 8 - % phone, Spinal Maningitis and T.B. of brain (Drs. think)
Josephine Jenowak - 32 - internal cancer - has three little children - Mother asks for prayers.
Page 225 Aug. 5th Miss Fannie E. Boston - Elderly - non Catholic principle in School - to have operation as feared.
6 Louis Krause - 14 - Ruptured Apendix operation 3 weeks ago today - Drs. give little hope.
Mrs. Pearl Mulligan - 42 - at present with her folks in Prince E'd Isle., Ca. - cancer sh'ing and pluricy. Was enrolled in May and as- tonished doctors .. went home and has been quite well till recently when pluricy etc. seemed to threaten (see July 6th)
Carl Sherbrook - 20 about - methodist - fits.
Mr & Mrs. Bataille - Doctors - fearful accident ... both nearly killed.
7 Thomas Franek - 13 - Near Pittsburgh, Pa. - here today - tuomer on brain removed June 19th last yr - unable to use right arm or leg ....
Francis Fitzpatrick - 19 - went blind in swiming Aug. July 30th - After four days recovered ... This a.m. after four days seeing loses sight again.
